publication_name: Consumer price index, all items, Japan, 2025 = 100, three-decimal reference index, calendar month, not seasonally adjusted
access_description: Public CSV on the Statistics Bureau site. No API key. One Japan all-items reference series, group code 0001.
conditions: Cite the Statistics Bureau and the page URL. Do not present an edited figure as an unedited official figure. This row is the three-decimal reference index, not the one-decimal official presentation. Store the file value unaltered.
revision_behaviour: The CSV is the current reference file, not a historical vintage panel. Content may change without notice. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted and are not stored as zero.
unresolved_questions: The terms do not name AI processing or model training, so those operations stay unknown. One current file cannot reconstruct vintages from before they are collected.
evidence_note: Assessed 2026-10-24. Statistics Bureau terms at https://www.stat.go.jp/info/riyou.html state: 当サイトで公開している情報（以下「コンテンツ」といいます。）は、どなたでも以下の1）～4）に従って、複製、公衆送信、翻訳・変形等の翻案等、自由に利用できます。商用利用も可能です。また、数値データ、簡単な表・グラフ等は著作権の対象ではありませんので、これらについては本利用ルールの適用はなく、自由に利用できます。 Source citation is requested. The same page's reference-index section states: 公式の数値については、従来と同様、指数と変化率は小数第1位までの表章とします。 The bound file is the three-decimal reference CSV for Japan, monthly, group code 0001, header 総合 / All items. It is a price index, 2025 = 100, not a nominal yen amount and not a real volume. Periods are calendar months, not fiscal years. It is not the separate table titled 季節調整済指数. A non-persisting read on 2026-10-24 contained months 202501 to 202609 for that column. The file is latest-revised, not a historical vintage panel. includeHistory is not requested. The e-Stat API is not used because it requires an application ID. No secret is used. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000.
